description: The shipped sources `packages/core` compiles clean and `@hyperfixi/engine` rejects (packages/testing-framework/src/multilingual/shipped-sources-engine.test.ts). The engine is meant to replace core's, so this is what that would break in our own examples and docs. A NEW rejected source outside this list fails the gate, and so does a listed key the engine now reads: the list only shrinks, and it is empty when the replacement breaks no shipped page.
note: The `key` is file::sha1(source)[0:10], so it changes when the source is edited. First measured 2026-10-01 at 78 sources. 62 went by rewriting the examples and docs in upstream's spelling where upstream has one (each rewrite run on core, upstream 0.9.93 and the engine, to the same DOM), 4 more of those turned up behind the first parse error, and the engine gained two forms it keeps from core (`new X()`, `toggle <element>`: packages/engine/src/additions.ts). By form, and beside upstream's verdict: `npx tsx packages/engine/tools/shipped-sources.mts`.

rejected.excerpt: on click halt the event remove .active from <a/> in #boosted-nav add .active to me add .hx-swapping
rejected.reason: history commands: core's `push url` / `replace url`. Upstream has no such command (a page writes `call history.pushState(null, '', url)`). Left as written on purpose: whether the engine gets them is decided with the htmx layer (owner, 2026-10-01).
